title: The slightly unethical strategy I used to beat the market by stealing strategies
author: AllRealityIsVirtua1
selftext:
I’m copying the info from a post I made in algotrading after I discovered this sub. 

1. Find and take the top performing strategies. This is the hardest part. I use iftrades’s $5 plan (free trial program ended after this got popular) because they give access to the top strategies the past quarter. 

2. Use the settings page to export the strategies as a json file. This is important as it makes it easy for LLMs. Export as many strategies as you have access to. Save them to a folder 

3. Use frontier LLMs to analyze the riskiest aspects of each strategy, and create 5+ strategies from the learnings, start paper trading immediately. 

This consistently gets me a couple of profitable strategies. As big of a sample size as you can get it best. This helped me beat both the SP500 and BTC this past quarter. It’s best to monitor it daily.
